text: Migration Assistant lets you transfer files and settings from your old PC or Mac to a new Mac quickly
quote: With Migration Assistant, setting up a new Mac is still quick and easy — even if you’re migrating from Windows.

text: Make phone calls from your Mac without needing to use your iPhone
quote: make a call without reaching for your iPhone

text: Automatically continue an activity started on one Apple device on another nearby device
quote: When your Mac and your iPhone or iPad are near each other, they can automatically pass what you’re doing from one device to another.

text: Copy content on iPhone/iPad and paste it on a nearby Mac, or vice versa
quote: Copy images, video, or text from an app on your iPhone or iPad. Then paste into another app on your nearby Mac — or vice versa.

text: Continuity Camera lets a photo taken on iPhone instantly appear inside a Mac app like Mail
quote: With Continuity Camera, you can take a photo with your iPhone and instantly see it in an email on your Mac.

text: iPhone Mirroring lets you view and control your iPhone directly from your Mac
quote: iPhone Mirroring lets you see and use your iPhone right from your Mac.

text: AirDrop enables simple wireless file sharing between Mac, iPhone, and iPad
quote: AirDrop makes sharing files between Mac, iPhone, and iPad simple.

text: Share and view video or presentation content from another Apple device on your Mac's screen
quote: Share content — like videos or Keynote slides — from another Apple device on the big, high‑quality screen of your Mac.

text: Sidecar lets you use an iPad with Apple Pencil as a drawing/creative input for Mac apps
quote: Sidecar brings the ease and precision of Apple Pencil to your favorite creative Mac apps as well. Use Apple Pencil to create in Adobe InDesign, edit photos in Affinity Photo 2, or generate 3D models in Maxon ZBrush.

text: Universal Control lets one keyboard and mouse/trackpad control both Mac and iPad with cursor moving between them
quote: thanks to Universal Control, you can control both your Mac and your iPad with a single keyboard and mouse or trackpad, moving your cursor fluidly between them.

text: Continuity Markup lets you annotate or sign documents on iPad/iPhone with changes appearing live on Mac
quote: Continuity Markup lets you sign documents, correct papers, or circle important details in images. Use your Apple Pencil on iPad or your finger on iPhone and see changes live on your Mac.

text: Instant Hotspot lets your Mac remotely turn on your nearby iPhone's Personal Hotspot
quote: With Instant Hotspot, your Mac can remotely activate the Personal Hotspot on your iPhone when they are near each other.

text: Bringing your iPhone near a new Mac lets Setup Assistant sign you into Wi-Fi and your Apple Account automatically
quote: Just bring your iPhone near your Mac, and Setup Assistant signs you in to your Wi-Fi network and Apple Account.

text: Spotlight lets you search and perform actions system-wide without opening apps
quote: use Spotlight to search and take action without opening apps

text: Get automatic translation of calls and messages
quote: get automatic translations in calls and messages

text: Built-in tools manage passwords and protect privacy including private browsing
quote: Your Mac includes built-in tools to protect your important information—from password management to private browsing and beyond.

Shortcuts lets you automate repetitive tasks on the system
